Gate 7A: Subgroup / Measurement Audit

Source: R/gate_07a_subgroups.R
Gate7aSubgroups.Rd

In the updated framework, subgroup audits are a default expectation for claims that might generalize to people/groups. This gate assesses:

  • Subgroup-specific performance metrics

  • Subgroup-specific calibration (and, for decision support, consequences / utility)

The gate operates on declared subgroup variables (e.g., ctx$sensitive_features) or task$col_roles$stratum.

For high-stakes decision/deployment contexts, missing subgroup declarations are treated as a hard evidentiary failure.

Binary Classification

Computes per-group AUC, Brier score, ECE, calibration intercept/slope, and (if utility/cost specification provided) expected utility or cost.

Regression

Computes per-group RMSE.
